relation.note: His son al-Jamāl Muḥammad b. Ḥasan b. Ilyās al-Rūmī al-Ḥanafī (AIND-D07337; d. Mecca, Rajab 860). Direction corrected: the subject is the father ("wa-huwa wālid al-Jamāl Muḥammad al-ātī").
Luʾluʾ al-Ḥasanī (TMP-P-000676, new): one of the named khuddām affiliated to him; the nisba "al-Ḥasanī" derives from al-Ḥasan b. Ilyās himself.
Marjān al-Ḥasanī (TMP-P-000677, new): one of the named khuddām affiliated to him.

person.note: アル＝ハサン・ブン・イリヤース・アッ＝ルーミーは、高名な商人たちのうちの一人であり、彼には、ルゥルゥー・アル＝ハサニーやマルジャーン・アル＝ハサニーといった召使たちが属していた。彼はハバシャで亡くなり、後述のアル＝ジャマール・ムハンマドの父である。

al-Ḥasan b. Ilyās al-Rūmī was one of the prominent and esteemed merchants, to whom a group of servants, including Luʾluʾ al-Ḥasanī and Marjān al-Ḥasanī, were affiliated. He died in Abyssinia, and he is the father of al-Jamāl Muḥammad (mentioned later).
